card.name: Digits inside citation page numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits or separators partway through page or paragraph numbers in scholarly citations and footnotes, such as after 'pp.', 'p1', or inside brackets like [FC37].

modes.label: Digit inside page number
modes.description: A digit in the middle or end of a page or section number in a reference.

modes.label: Bracketed document citation
modes.description: A digit inside a bracketed church-document or source reference.
modes.example: [FC3<<7>>]. Education must pass along human culture,

modes.label: Separator before page numbers
modes.description: A comma or space between year or page and the next number in a citation.

card.plain: It fires on the numbers inside page and footnote references in academic or religious texts.
